title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. In recognition of this volume, we have revised our offer to €135.70 per unit, maintaining the 1 November 2026 effective date and 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot is a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

We cannot accommodate the delayed effective dates or extended payment terms in your other proposals, as our material and labor costs have already risen. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings: volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for our long partnership. To your question: all our packages bind the full 8150 pc per year over a 12-month contract.

PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%. Our bottom-up should-cost for this casing at your plant is EUR 132.64 per piece (cost:310010).

The attached packages trade a later effective date or different payment terms against price. If faster cash matters to you, please tell us which package works best. We would be glad to have it as your standing offer. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper casing variant is possible?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings: volume commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Acknowledging this solid data and your firm commitment to 8150 pieces, we can offer a price of €132.90 per unit, maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms and the 1 November 2026 effective date. For this proposal, the Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, with Lieferzeit valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our technical colleagues will contact you to discuss whether a cheaper casing variant is feasible without compromising our high quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – final alignment on packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for the constructive revision. We value our partnership and want a stable arrangement for both sides. All packages cover the full 8150 pc per year over a 12-month contract.

PPI-D351 also fell over twelve months, from 137.0 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08) to 131.9 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-08), a change of -3.72%. Your on-time delivery in 2026Q3 was 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3), which we need to factor into the value of the supply.

You asked earlier about faster payment, so one package offers payment in 14 days. If that helps your cash flow, we would gladly take it as your standing offer. Which earliest lead time could you confirm for call-offs?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – final alignment on packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. The index change you mentioned is a duplicate of the data we already accounted for in our previous offer. We can accept your terms and await your order. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €131.70 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 14 days net, a Lieferzeit of 42 days, and is valid from 1 November 2026 for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
